is_reco_electron.name: is_reco_electron
is_reco_electron.description: Tracks are assumed to be electrons based on tracking algorithm classification
is_reco_electron.physics: Selects electron-like tracks from the tracker quality information

one_reco_electron.name: one_reco_electron
one_reco_electron.description: Exactly one reconstructed electron per event
one_reco_electron.physics: Event-level cut to ensure single-particle signature, reduces backgrounds from multi-track events

is_reco_positron.name: is_reco_positron
is_reco_positron.description: Tracks are assumed to be positrons based on tracking algorithm classification
is_reco_positron.physics: Selects positron-like tracks (opposite charge from electrons)

has_downstream.name: has_downstream
has_downstream.description: Downstream tracks with forward momentum (p_z > 0) through tracker
has_downstream.physics: Requires tracks to pass through downstream tracker detector, rejects upstream-only tracks

mc_is_electron.name: mc_is_electron
mc_is_electron.physics: Simulation-only cut for validation, ensures we're looking at true electron tracks

has_trk_front.name: has_trk_front
has_trk_front.description: Track has at least one segment intersecting TT_Front surface
has_trk_front.physics: Requires track segment at front of tracker to ensure well-measured momentum

good_trkpid.name: good_trkpid
good_trkpid.description: Track PID > 0.638 - strong particle identification criterion
good_trkpid.physics: Particle ID selection to separate electrons from other particles, threshold optimized for signal efficiency

good_trkqual.name: good_trkqual
good_trkqual.description: Track quality > 0.2 - measure of tracking algorithm confidence
good_trkqual.physics: Quality of fit metric from tracking algorithm, removes poorly reconstructed tracks

within_t0.name: within_t0
within_t0.description: t0 at tracker mid (500 < t_0 < 1650 ns) - time window selection
within_t0.physics: Timing gate at tracker middle, selects events within expected beam timing window

within_t0err.name: within_t0err
within_t0err.description: t0 error < 0.9 ns - time measurement precision requirement
within_t0err.physics: Requires precise time measurement, removes events with poorly determined timing

has_hits.name: has_hits
has_hits.description: Minimum of 20 active hits in tracker - requires sufficient track information
has_hits.physics: Minimum number of tracker hits ensures good track reconstruction quality

within_lhr_maxl.name: within_lhr_maxl
within_lhr_maxl.description: Loop helix maximum radius constraint (450 < R_max < 680 mm) - track geometry cut
within_lhr_maxl.physics: Curvature constraint on track fit, selects expected track radius for signal momentum range

within_d0.name: within_d0
within_d0.description: Distance of closest approach d_0 < 100 mm - impact parameter requirement
within_d0.physics: Impact parameter cut, constrains track to originate from interaction vertex region

within_pitch_angle.name: within_pitch_angle
within_pitch_angle.description: Extrapolated pitch angle 0.5577 < tan(θ_Dip) < 1.0 - momentum direction cut
within_pitch_angle.physics: Pitch angle selection ensures track has expected angular distribution for signal

has_st.name: has_st
has_st.description: Track has N_ST > 0 - intersects Stopping Target
has_st.physics: Track must pass through Stopping Target where muon originated

no_opa.name: no_opa
no_opa.description: Track avoids OPA (N_OPA == 0) - rejects tracks through outer proton absorber
no_opa.physics: Removes tracks that pass through outer proton absorber, indicates non-signal background

no_crv_veto.name: no_crv_veto
no_crv_veto.description: No high-quality CRV coincidence (PEs>25, nHits≥15, span<175ns)
no_crv_veto.physics: Cosmic ray veto using Cosmic Ray Tracker, rejects events with cosmic hits

crv_quality.name: crv_quality
crv_quality.description: No CRV coincidence with start>429 and end<1700 ns within dt threshold
crv_quality.physics: CRV timing consistency check, removes poorly reconstructed cosmic hits

no_crv_timewindow.name: no_crv_timewindow
no_crv_timewindow.description: No CRV-track time veto: |Δt| ≥ 150 ns - cosmic ray rejection
no_crv_timewindow.physics: Requires minimum time separation between track and CRV hit, cosmic ray rejection

pz_pt.name: pz_pt
pz_pt.physics: Momentum direction cut ensuring track is mostly forward-going, rejects wide-angle scatters

triggers.name: triggers
triggers.physics: Hardware/software trigger selection, ensures event came from expected trigger path

within_mom_time.name: within_mom_time
within_mom_time.description: 95 < momentum < 115 MeV/c - narrow momentum window for signal region
within_mom_time.physics: Tight momentum window around expected signal value (104.8 MeV/c for mu→e), signal optimization

within_mom_time_pos.name: within_mom_time_pos
within_mom_time_pos.description: t0 at tracker mid (0 < t_0 < 700 ns) - early time window for positrons
within_mom_time_pos.physics: Early timing window for positron signal search, different from electron window

early_time.name: early_time
early_time.description: Veto tracks with reflections - no loop helix fit requirement
early_time.physics: Removes tracks with loop-like topology indicating multiple scattering or background

reflected.name: reflected
reflected.physics: Placeholder or test cut, behavior depends on analysis configuration

metadata.source: analyze.py - cut definitions from Mu2e pyCount reference analysis
metadata.description: Cut descriptions and physics rationale for all analysis cuts
